story_type: downed pilot point of view, helicopter water extraction drill
hook: What a downed pilot sees when the rescue helicopter comes.
narration: This is what a downed pilot sees when the rescue helicopter comes.
It was a Navy rescue drill off Guam, in December 2013.
First, be seen. A smoke flare marks the raft.
The Seahawk comes in low, and its rotor wash tears up the water.
A swimmer drops in and reaches the raft.
Then one cable lifts them both.
outcome: The swimmer and the pilot rode the cable up into the helicopter.
title: Rescue seen from the life raft
description:
During Exercise Forager Fury II off Guam on Dec. 11, 2013, Navy Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron 25 practiced a combat search and rescue water extraction, filmed in part from the raft of the simulated downed pilot.

Footage: U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Jacob A. Hug, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/312127/combat-search-and-rescue-water-extraction
